text: The Qatar 1812km is hosted at the Lusail International Circuit with the Qatar Motor & Motorcycle Federation (QMMF), both state-linked bodies, while Amnesty International reports that Qatar's migrant workers remain exposed to exploitation despite kafala reform and that expression and assembly are tightly restricted.
short: Qatar state bodies host the WEC season opener; Amnesty documents migrant-worker exploitation and restricted expression

source.name: Amnesty International - Human rights in Qatar (country report)
